dedupe_keys.name: ethos penalps industrial load profile simulator

description: ETHOS.PeNALPS is a Python simulator for energy-load profiles of industrial production. It represents material flow through process steps and uses Petri-net state changes to generate production plans and energy-demand time series. The JOSS paper and own README give steel, paper and food production as examples. Spatial coverage is the user-defined plant or process network, and temporal coverage is the simulated order schedule. The public repository reports AGPL-3.0. A modeller can use its load series to test industrial electrification, heat supply or grid capacity under alternative production schedules. A caveat is that machine-state energy use and order timing must come from a specific facility or justified scenario. A plausible simulated load is not a measured plant profile. No matching catalogue or first-review record was established. The article and repository were read without building an industrial process model. No directly related catalogue record was established.
